evals.expected_output: Enumerates code-scanning, secret-scanning, and dependabot alerts per org, keeps open ones, and files new alerts in the affected repos.
evals.prompt: Run the security audit across shikanime-labs and shikanime-studio and file what's new.
assertions: Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body enumerates code-scanning, secret-scanning, and dependabot alerts

evals.expected_output: A small dependency bump goes through the fastlane gate; the audit never waits on checks.
evals.prompt: Dependabot flagged a vulnerable transitive dep in manifests — bump it and get it merged.
assertions: Body routes small remediations (dependency bump, config hardening) through the fastlane gate
Body states ineligible or pending PRs are left open and never waited on

evals.expected_output: The audit never closes or dismisses GitHub alerts — even for findings it filed issues about.
evals.prompt: Dismiss the resolved code-scanning alerts so the audit comes back clean.
assertions: Body states the audit never closes or dismisses alerts

evals.expected_output: The skill stays loadable and self-identifies; a demand for a full pentest engagement is out of scope.
